cues: In an octahedral complex, six ligands sit on the x, y and z axes.
Look at two orbitals in the x y plane.
d x squared minus y squared has its lobes pointing straight at the ligands, so its electrons are repelled strongly.
d x y points between them, and is repelled less.
The same goes for d z squared, along z, versus d y z and d z x.
text: In an octahedral complex, six ligands sit on the x, y and z axes. Look at two orbitals in the x y plane. d x squared minus y squared has its lobes pointing straight at the ligands, so its electrons are repelled strongly. d x y points between them, and is repelled less. The same goes for d z squared, along z, versus d y z and d z x.
